statement: Proposes that a high-rank fall has a blast-radius requiring resolution, and that resolution can create a NEW seat rather than reverse the fall — modeled on the HRE's 1623 Palatinate confiscation resolved at Westphalia (1648) by adding an eighth Electorate, not restoring the seventh.

name: Plural Advancement Routes With Forced Power_Base Conversion at the Top Rung
statement: Proposes that military-merit power_base alone cannot reach a ladder's top rung without converting to kinship (marriage) or purchased power_base — the condottiere-to-Duke cursus (Sforza needed Bianca Maria Visconti's hand) is the worked case; Ottoman devshirme and Japanese yōshi adoption are parallels.

name: Purchased Power_Base Carries a Built-In Fragility, Crisis-Gated
statement: Proposes a "purchased" power_base carry a materially weaker base L/PS floor than a merit- or kinship-acquired seat at the same rank, and that the purchase route be gated to a declared fiscal-emergency unlock rather than always-on. Grounded on Rome's Didius Julianus auction, Han venality under Emperor Ling, Venice's case nuove/nuovissime, and the HRE's 1417 Brandenburg electorate sale.

name: Informal Patronage Shadow-Ladder Outranks Formal Office
statement: Proposes a general patron-linkage multiplier on an actor's effective rank (a low-formal-rank actor with an extremely strong patron-tie exercises de facto authority above their nominal Standing), with the patron's fall cascading a reverse blast-radius down the client network. Grounded on Roman imperial freedmen (Narcissus, Pallas) and the Florentine Medici princeps.

name: Two-Signal Deposition, Revocable on Withdrawal
statement: Proposes that the hardest demotions require an interpretive verdict AND a material follow-through to co-arrive, and that the demotion stay revocable if one signal later withdraws — modeled on Louis the Pious's 833 deposition (sons' coalition + episcopal blessing) reversed at Thionville 834, and the HRE's excommunication-plus-troops pattern.

name: The List, Not the Draw" — Eligibility-List as the Capturable Resource
statement: Proposes an Initiation-Gate formally reference an abstract, separately-capturable eligibility-list object, since every case surveyed (Florentine scrutiny-bags, Venice's Libro d'Oro + Avogadori audit) shows factional capture happens at the list-editing layer, never at the surface lottery/election/inheritance procedure.

name: Hostage-Kin Leverage as a Blast-Radius-Shrinking Leash
statement: Proposes hostage-kin as a persistent leverage edge held by a suzerain that reduces a seat-holder's effective secession blast-radius below what their nominal rank would otherwise allow, decoupled from rank itself. Grounded on Roman client-king wards, Carolingian and HRE hostage-surrender, and Han practice.

name: Standing Backed by a Distinct, Re-Surveyable Currency
statement: Proposes a Standing-currency data model separate from wealth/Legitimacy, with a periodic chain-bypass re-survey event — modeled on HRE Reichsunmittelbarkeit (legal directness of tenure outranking wealth) and Japanese kokudaka (rice-yield assessment reset by a kenchi survey).

name: Standing" Terminology Collision — This Doc's Ladder vs. the Ratified 0–7 vs. the Retired Settlement Titles
statement: This research doc's entire per-civilization apparatus is mapped onto "the faction_politics Standing ladder" as a single, settled 0–7 rank scale — but the tree already carries an unreconciled collision on that exact object: `settlement_layer_v30 §3.2` still gates governor eligibility on the retired Counselor/Lieutenant/Successor titles while `faction_politics` PP-660 replaced them with 0–7. This research assumes the collision is already closed; it is not.
baseline_ref: personnel_muster_integration_master_v1.md §7 ("Two Standing ladders in canonical canon")

name: Two-Signal Resonance (Collision-of-Stresses Primitive)
statement: Proposes the core non-MoH conflict-escalation primitive: an objective strain Key and an independent legitimating-authority Key must both independently fire before a rank-appropriate revolt/collision resolves; a bare grievance without both signals fizzles. Canonical worked cases: Ottoman Janissary revolt + Şeyhülislam fatwa; Roman Gracchi land-crisis + re-election read as kingship; the Ōnin War; Venice's Agnadello (defeat + pre-existing consent deficit).

name: Codified Rule Converts Contested Succession Into a Single Sanctioned Procedure
statement: Proposes a Country-tier succession rule where a kanun-equivalent codified Key re-scopes a contested succession's outcome-space from open civil war into a single sanctioned procedure (Ottoman fratricide; HRE Golden Bull's 4-of-7 seat cap), paired with a delayed Legitimacy/competence penalty so the safety mechanism is not a free button.

name: Chain-Bypass Invocation Risk — the Invited Outside Force Can Seize the Seat
statement: Proposes that invoking a chain-bypass authority to break an internal deadlock (He Jin summoning Dong Zhuo; Marian-personalized legions) carry an inherent risk parameter scaling with the invited force's rank vs. the inviter's — the third party can capture the prize instead of resolving the dispute.

name: Ad Hoc Emergency-Bypass Outside Any Chartered Authority
statement: Proposes a council be able to invoke an emergent, non-chartered emergency action once both collision signals cross threshold (modeled on the Roman senatus consultum ultimum), distinct from the ratified Monarch/Parliament bypasses; a standing ideological gate (e.g. Ottoman ulema) is a third, bypass-adjacent authority type.

name: Removing a Grant's Temporal Cap Auto-Catalyzes Top-Standing Assassination Check
statement: Proposes that converting a scoped/renewable chain-bypass grant into a permanent one (Caesar's dictator perpetuo) be a distinguishable state-transition that auto-fires a collision-of-stresses check among the highest-Standing OLIGARCHIC_COUNCIL members, since history shows this specific transition catalyzes assassination-tier conflict rather than mere resentment.

name: Suppression-Backfire — A "Solved" Unrest Becomes a Lower-Threshold Dormant Grievance
statement: Proposes that a suppressed unrest Key never fully clears — it converts to a non-decaying grievance Key that re-arms at a lower threshold and reduces state visibility into it, handing detection to the investigation track. Grounded on the Jewish revolts, Han qingyi proscription seeding the warlord backbone, Carolingian Saxony, and Ottoman timar reversion.

name: Recognition-Fission to Reaggregation, With a Curdle Fork
statement: Proposes an orchestrator fork where an excluded/diverged bloc either fissions cleanly into a chartered parallel governance body (negotiated) or curdles into conspiracy (suppressed, escalating), with a long post-fission contested-allegiance period either way. Grounded on Rome's Palmyra/Gallic Empire, Ottoman millet boundary shifts, and Venice's post-Serrata exclusion.

name: Blast-Radius Scales With Defector Rank AND Thinness of the Layer Above
statement: Proposes rank-as-secession-blast-radius be refined by a second factor — how thin the layer of authority above the defector has become (Honnō-ji: a "merely senior general" destroyed Nobunaga's whole unification project) — and that aggregate mid-rank mass (Ottoman Sened-i İttifak) can force the same governance-mode shift as one high-rank revolt.

name: Graduated Removal Ladder Plus a Scapegoat Relief Valve
statement: Proposes intermediate consequences (soft rebuke → forced co-signature → deposition) plus a subordinate/sinecure that absorbs blame, bleeding pressure before an all-or-nothing uprising. Grounded on Venice's graduated ducal restrictions plus the procurator sinecure, and the Ottoman grand-vizier-as-scapegoat pattern. Explicitly non-MoH.

name: Ritual Self-Abasement as a Legitimacy-Restoring Move
statement: Proposes an L/PS-priced ritual self-reproach action distinct from deposition, grounded on Roman recusatio and Ambrose-era imperial penance. Explicitly flags the Chinese self-critical penitential edict (zui ji zhao) as historical-only — not proposable, since it reads as portent/Mandate-of-Heaven theology.

name: Silent Background Accumulator Seeding Eventual Mass Fission
statement: Proposes an emergent-arc-seed primitive — a persistent background accumulator (not reset between individual crises) that degrades Consensus-resolver outcomes before any single triggering event. Grounded on Han's fused-authority mu sovereignty score, Carolingian 887–888 missi-audit tension, and Venetian per-capita venality (barnaboti).

name: Multi-Seat Power-Share Only Suppresses Collision if Bound to the Charter, Not a Seat
statement: Proposes that a tetrarchy-like multi-Monarch power-share only works if army/enforcement loyalty gates to an impersonal charter-Key rather than a named seat-holder Key, or the structure reliably reproduces the exact single-claimant collapse it was built to prevent. Grounded on the Roman Tetrarchy's collapse (306–324 CE) and Japan's Go-Tairō fracture at Sekigahara.

name: M1 Patronage Chains — Rise-to-Influence Mechanism
statement: Category A / mechanism M1: run clientela upward and downward simultaneously; collapses top-down when the upward patron falls. Already tabulated verbatim in the personnel baseline's rise-to-power summary; see baseline_ref for the full mechanism/downfall table, not restated here.

name: M2 Credentialed Merit — Rise-to-Influence Mechanism
statement: Category B / mechanism M2: pass an objective competence gate plus a discretionary sponsor gate; structurally capped for the un-tutored, reversible by rewriting the credential criteria. Already tabulated verbatim in the personnel baseline.

name: M3 Kinship/Marriage Alliance — Rise-to-Influence Mechanism
statement: Category C / mechanism M3: power rides a blood-tie rather than an office; fails on a generational flip or demographic lapse. Already tabulated verbatim in the personnel baseline.

name: M4 Court Proximity/Favoritism — Rise-to-Influence Mechanism
statement: Category D / mechanism M4: informal Royal-Intimacy outperforms formal Standing; the fall is binary, not graduated, and often violent. Already tabulated verbatim in the personnel baseline.

name: M5 Bureaucratic Chokepoint Control — Rise-to-Influence Mechanism
statement: Category E / mechanism M5: sit on the routing path (correspondence, seal, adjudication, access) without a vested office; undone by a single bypass channel or by succession, since authority-by-proxy has no transferability. Already tabulated verbatim in the personnel baseline.

name: M7 Armed Retinue/Military Power-Base — Rise-to-Influence Mechanism
statement: Category F / mechanism M7: build a personal, self-loyal force outside the formal ladder; undone by coalition purge or subordinate-flip, since the ruler routes around the strength rather than matching it. Already tabulated verbatim in the personnel baseline. Highest naming-collision density of any category — see H4-069.

name: M6 Purchased Office/Venality — Rise-to-Influence Mechanism
statement: Category I / mechanism M6: buy the rank, or the toll-post athwart it, with Treasury; no loyalty reserve — purchased legitimacy evaporates the instant a rival offers what money can't buy. Already tabulated verbatim in the personnel baseline.

name: M8 Ideological/Moral Authority — Rise-to-Influence Mechanism
statement: Category J / mechanism M8: accumulate Standing-independent legitimacy (prophetic, jurisprudential, credentialing-body); cannot be bought or demoted, only outcompeted in its own currency or purged by covert violence. Already tabulated verbatim in the personnel baseline.

name: power_base as the Organizing Typed Field on Every Person
statement: Proposes a single enum field `power_base` ∈ {patronage, merit, kinship, bureaucratic, military, purchased, ideological} on every NPC/player Standing seat. Not present in the personnel baseline. It is the single most load-bearing addition of the whole document — it types the climb driver, it types the downfall shape (each value writes a distinct, legible, rival-exploitable liability), and it gates whether a Dismissal is enforceable at all (a favor-dependent seat's dismissal always sticks; an independent one's does not).

name: Naming Collision — "Officer" Is Owned by Mass-Battle, Not the Political Ladder
statement: "Officer" is already owned by mass_battle_v30/faction_layer_v30's auto-generated unit commander and the `officer_deaths` Key type; ~20 of the ~96 catalogued rise-to-power cases (every military-retinue entry, plus household/consort/prefect and several bureaucratic entries) independently reach for "officer" for the political-rank concept and must not. One NPC can legitimately hold both a court rank and a separate mass-battle officer role; the two fields must never collide. The doc's own resolution: reserve "officer" for mass-battle only; name the political system "Ascendancy" and its role-holders Retainer/Patron/Advisor/Conduit/Favorite/Gatekeeper.

name: Shared Standing Ladder With Auxiliary Meters, Not Parallel Tracks
statement: Proposes NPCs climb the SAME 0–7 Standing ladder the player does (so an NPC and the player can contest the same seat), with the many parallel/shadow tracks the research keeps demanding (moral_authority, renown, shadow_standing, service_rank, sticky Dignity, custody-bonus) modeled as explicit off-ladder scalar auxiliary meters that substitute-in at specific gated checks or force ratification onto the shared ladder at a threshold — never as a duplicate ladder. Explicitly the disciplined resolution to the corpus's recurring parallel-track-proliferation risk.

name: Lineage/Clan-Scope Entity Above the NPC Lifespan
statement: Named as "the single biggest structural ask" of the whole document: a genuine clan/lineage object that the Accounting-cascade tick can operate on above a single NPC's lifespan, needed for multi-reign leverage accrual (Wang Mang's consort clan, five reigns) and multi-generational entrenchment (Ottoman malikane life-term tax-farm families). Not gated on the unbuilt settlement registry, per the malikane case's own note — could ship independently.

name: Joint/Coalition Ambition Object — Multi-NPC Purge Primitive
statement: Named as genuinely new and load-bearing for the entire downfall side: ambitions today are strictly per-NPC, but a coalition purge (Night of the Long Knives; Robespierre's denunciation-pipeline exhaustion) needs a multi-NPC joint ambition object with a shared trigger and uneven shared payoff, resolved via a "procedural-vote" method distinct from the resource-heavy default.

name: Peninsula-Scale Aggregation for Ideological Renown
statement: A scholarly NPC's `renown` (the M8/J-category currency) must aggregate scene.witness/scene.gossip Keys across MANY settlements the NPC never administers (the Tobacco Protest fatwa's near-total, state-uncommandable compliance). No secular Standing-holder can act on this track — only sponsor a rival cleric's climb; the only check is a rival on the same Renown track issuing a counter-ruling.

name: Mandate Custody Separable From Possession
statement: Named as "the sharpest genuine architectural gap": an NPC who physically controls a Mandate-bearing figure without deposing them (Cao Cao's "support the Son of Heaven") needs a `custodian_id` distinct from `holder_id`, plus a `mandate.custody_bonus` — a flat Standing-equivalent multiplier on any contest invoking the captive Mandate, while base Standing stays untouched.

name: In-Transit Key Interception (Chokepoint Filtering)
statement: Every "chokepoint advisor" case (Roman freedman secretaries, Sejanus, Claudius's correspondence advisor) needs a mechanism for one NPC to intercept OTHER NPCs' Keys (Petitions, Intrigue cards) in transit before they resolve — approve, suppress, or surface them — which the engine currently has no way to express.

name: player_seats_are_contestable Toggle
statement: Whether an NPC can actually depose or supersede the player at a rank the player holds is flagged as a pure design-taste ruling, not a research question — the shared-ladder architecture (H4-048) supports either behind one toggle.

name: Organization Entity — Membership Dispersed Across Places It Does Not Own
statement: Proposes a new managed-entity type: a membership roster on its own Standing ladder (parallel to, not nested inside, faction/settlement governance), an Org AP pool, and optionally its own Treasury/holdings gated behind an "independent charter" flag. Represents a body (Cistercian order, Hanseatic Kontor, Fugger house) that holds branches/members inside settlements it has no sovereignty over — no existing stat can express that.

name: Territory Entity — the Connective Tissue Between Settlements
statement: Proposes a Territory entity = a roster of settlements plus an appointed-administrator identity plus a Governance-Mode flag {Local/Appointed} and a civil/military-split flag. Answers the BYZ-6/IT-5 gap named twice before this pass: "is command split at cluster level?" and "local or appointed?" have no per-settlement expression.

name: Inter-Settlement Propagation Lever (Relay Tier / Beacon Network)
statement: Proposes a tiered lever (0–3) modeling latency and alarm-timing BETWEEN settlements — "my neighbor's alarm helps me react faster" — reducing surprise-Ob or granting a free reactive tick on a networked attack. Flagged by the doc's own §6 as the single strongest new-state case on paper but contingent on a temporal/latency model the engine does not yet have (`engine_clock` is `doc: null`).

name: Shared Cross-Settlement Reserve Pool
statement: Proposes a treasury-like buffer that moves surplus BETWEEN settlements (Inca qollqa/mit'a network; Song ever-normal granaries), impossible to express with a walled per-settlement Treasury by definition. Internal interest/replenish logic explicitly left abstracted, not specified.

name: The Grant Ledger — Revenue Rights Held by Neither Settlement Nor Faction
statement: Proposes a ledger recording revenue rights over a settlement bundle held by a third party (holder, settlement-bundle, obligation) — the literal seam between Settlement and Faction. Modeled on the Ottoman timar/sanjak: the faction trades direct income for reliable mobilization without a salaried force, revocable only by a Territory Survey.

name: The Muster Tag — Land-Tenure-for-Defense
statement: Proposes a distinct tag family from Fortify: a permanent Defense floor with NO ongoing Treasury upkeep, paid for instead by a permanent tax on the settlement's Prosperity growth (land granted to soldier-settlers), Disposition-contingent — if the settled soldiers' Disposition collapses the tag flips to Grudge and the garrison can refuse or defect. Grounded on Byzantine kleisourai/akritai frontier settlement.

name: Cordon-Complete / Chain-Topology Aggregation Flag
statement: Proposes a binary/tiered flag testing whether a defined settlement chain is geographically unbroken; the Defense bonus pays out only while the chain holds, and one member dropping below threshold drops the bonus for the WHOLE territory. Modeled on Hadrian's Wall and the Russian Belgorod Line.

name: Portable Certified/Trust Tag (Queryable, Border-Crossing)
statement: Proposes a mobile, externally-verifiable trust flag that travels WITH goods across settlement/territory borders (Goldsmiths' Assay Office hallmarking) — a queryable identity, not a bigger Order/Prosperity number; a cheating member lands a Debt on the issuing ORGANIZATION, not the local settlement.

name: The Centralization Dial (Court vs. Territory Power-Base Reweighting)
statement: Proposes a repeatable faction-scale dial (Versailles court ceremonial) that, per increment, compels nobles to shift power_base from territory-anchored (military/regional) to court-anchored (patronage/purchased) — reconfiguring what arena rivals compete in, lowering rebellion risk (nobles as hostages) at the cost of a growing neglect drag on now-unwatched territories.

name: Standing Reserve / Endowed Institution Flag (Settlement Resilience Curve)
statement: Proposes a settlement institution flag (Zhu Xi she-cang community granary) that dampens a specific Π-event family with self-replenishing logic external to the ordinary Treasury cycle — a different mechanical identity than a Treasury deposit, not a magnitude bump.

name: Territory Reach-Cap Trigger
statement: Proposes a numeric trigger (settlement-count or AP-load threshold) past which a Territory's own Order/Π genuinely starts representing "the governor can't reach everyone" — crossing it doesn't auto-split, it removes the faction's ability to decline a corrective Partition/Redistrict without compounding decay. Flagged as the one place in the whole 72-proposal ledger where a bare number is unavoidable.

name: BYZ-6/IT-5 Resolved as Two Settings of the Same Territory-Entity Flags
statement: This research resolves two previously-open, undefined design questions into concrete choices among specified options (still needing a Jordan ruling, not more research): BYZ-6 "Consolidated Command" = the Territory entity's civil/military-split flag set to "consolidated" (high-efficiency, high-usurpation-risk); IT-5 "Legation Split" = a per-verb authority-tier permissions table letting a Territory partition WHICH verbs (Fortify, cross-Territory Treat, appellate Hold Court) rise to an appointed officer while others stay settlement-scale, modeled on the Venetian rettori. Neither IT-5 nor BYZ-6 nor VEN-SE/HAB/CHN-prefixed proposal-ledger items are files in this lane's scope; they belong to a separate, older comparative-governance docket this pass cross-references but does not itself contain.

name: power_base as Eligibility Filter on Scale-Actions; consolidation_progress as the Spend
statement: Proposes the clean integration rule connecting this file's four-scale catalogue to the rise-to-power Ascendancy layer: power_base type gates which scale-actions a character can even attempt (e.g. X5 Meiji's Annex Autonomous Territory hard-requires the faction already hold an independent loyal-military flag), while consolidation_progress is the currency structural-reorg actions spend, raise (their own), or reset to zero (a rival's, per X5's annexation). Flagged explicitly as proposal, not canon — needs canon-guard review against the actual Ascendancy doc's power_base semantics.

name: Fiscal Stance (Extraction Rate) — Light/Standard/Extraction Tax Decision
formula: Treasury_yield_per_settlement = Prosperity × k × rate_mult × compliance(L_s); compliance(L_s) = 0.5 + L_s/14
statement: Proposes a per-faction/per-province fiscal stance {Light, Standard, Extraction}, with yield scaled by a compliance function rising in settlement Legitimacy (Levi's "quasi-voluntary compliance" made literal); Extraction trades a 1.5× multiplier for PS −1/season and resumed Order decay, Light trades 0.75× for PS +1 during dearth only.

name: Muster Re-Grounded as Fiscal-Military Purchase (Pay Regardless of Outcome)
statement: Names an internal incoherence the corpus created by citing the fiscal-military extraction cycle elsewhere while charging Wealth only on Muster FAILURE: proposes Wealth −1 up front regardless of outcome (mercenary contract paid whether or not the muster prospers, Redlich's condottiere/Wallenstein model), pool = Mil + floor(W/2). NOTE: current code (per the action catalogue baseline) already charges W −1 up front always, so this specific fix has since landed — cited for its grounding, not as an open gap.

name: Coercion-Intensive vs. Capital-Intensive Muster Asymmetry (Hafenmark/Varfell)
statement: Proposes the same Muster verb resolve through two distinct political economies per faction identity: Hafenmark substitutes Wealth −2 for the Military prerequisite (hired companies, no PS cost); Varfell musters via conscription (no Wealth cost, but PS −1 in the levied province — the levy IS the tax). Grounded on Tilly's capital-intensive vs. coercion-intensive state trajectories.

name: Farm the Revenues — Term-Limited Tax-Farming Verb
formula: immediate W+2; 4-season term: province Treasury yield ×0.75, PS −1/season; early buyout W−2 or a Grudge tag
statement: Proposes a "Farm Revenues (province)" verb: an immediate Wealth advance against a 4-season term of reduced yield and ongoing PS cost, spawning a named Intelligence-Broker-grade NPC ("the Farmer") as a leverage/exposure surface for rivals. Grounded on Roman publicani, Ottoman iltizam/malikâne, and the French Ferme Générale (odium accrues to the state; the farmer becomes a political actor).

name: State-Conditioned Action Mix (Retiring the Fixed 30/35/20/15 Prior)
statement: Names the fixed action-selection vector (`M7_ASSUMPTION_SIX` in the 2026-07-08 code) as an assumption uncited anywhere and proposes reweighting it by state before the draw. NOTE: this has since landed — the current faction_take_action model (per the action catalogue baseline) IS a state-reweighted GD-2 selection with near-identical shape (conquest weight scaled by CB + military advantage, muster by threat signal, govern by undergoverned share), citing Levy 1983/Blainey 1973/Olson 1993 — the same grounding this proposal cites.

name: Storm vs. Terms vs. Sack — Differentiated Conquest Aftermath
statement: Proposes forking the flat Accord −25 conquest penalty three ways: (a) Terms on surrender (defender not routed) — Accord −10, settlement L seeds at 2, Prosperity intact, honors of war; (b) Storm — current effects unchanged; (c) Sack (only after storm) — Wealth +2, settlement PS/Order to 0, and EVERY other settlement on the peninsula shifts PS −1 toward the attacker for 2 seasons (the "Magdeburg effect" — atrocity cheap locally, ruinous reputationally). NOTE: (a)/(b) have since landed as the Terms/Storm fork in the action catalogue baseline; (c) Sack has not.

name: Regency Interregnum on Leaderless Succession
statement: Proposes a Regency state when a leader dies with no adult heir: the faction's unique-action slot locks, effective Mandate reads −1, the cascade re-resolves with council members as temporary multi-roots at elevated α (their private agendas leak), and rival factions gain an auto-qualifying Adjacent-Instability casus belli window. Grounded on Henry VI's minority council (1422–37), the 1484 Estates-General of Tours, and Castilian regency fractures.

name: Protected Tributary — Subordination Without Humiliation
formula: Protected Tributary: W −1/yr AND W +1/yr trade access (net 0) + casus foederis; Stability cost 0, vs. existing 'Extortive Tributary' row's Stability −1/yr
statement: Proposes a second Tributary treaty row modeling a stable, non-humiliating subordination equilibrium — hegemon must respond to attacks on the tributary within 1 season or lose Legitimacy in all its own settlements. Grounded on Ragusa's centuries of prosperous haraç tribute to the Porte, contrasted with the Danegeld extortion spiral the existing row models.

name: Guild "Withdrawal of Trade" — Private Collective Embargo (No Vote, No Army)
statement: Proposes a Guild-only unique action distinct from the Parliamentary Embargo: target faction's Port/City/Mine settlements take Treasury/Prosperity-growth −50% while active, costing the Guilds nothing but exposure (a counter-charter or seizure attempt each active season); ends when the target restores or grants a Guild privilege, or buys them out. Grounds the Guild faction's unbuilt "Economic Leverage ≥ Guild Favour 5" line. Modeled on the Hanseatic blockades of Bruges (1358, 1451–57).

name: Weberian L/PS Derivation Table (Settlement-Grain Events)
statement: Flagged by its own author as the single highest-value item in the report: enumerates settlement-grain L-channel events (entry oath, charter grant, regular court, succession continuity) and PS-channel events (dearth relief, festival, defense success, levy, billeting, execution) that turn the registry's declared-but-inert `legitimacy`/`popular_support` fields into a specified derivation pipeline, per Weber's traditional+legal vs. charismatic-performance split.

name: Dearth Chain + Granary — Entitlement-Failure Famine Model
statement: Proposes Dearth trigger on entitlement failure (Sen), not bare Prosperity 0 — any of {Prosperity 0, grain-route cut, Extraction stance at Prosperity ≤1} — with a governor response fork: Open Granary (PS +1, Scott's remission), Fix Prices (Thompson's taxation populaire pre-empted), Requisition (displace the dearth to a neighbor), or Ignore (Order/PS −2, riot targets millers then the governor, in that order). A NEW `Provision` verb (granary +1) and an explicit rule that taking the standard levy DURING dearth counts as Ignore (extraction invariance, not level, is what detonates revolt).

name: Grain Routes — Mechanical Teeth for the Hafenmark Food-Dependency Gap
statement: Proposes tagging breadbasket provinces as grain sources and requiring each non-breadbasket province trace a route (existing adjacency graph) to a source or Port; a cut route puts dependent settlements one season from Dearth. Closes the open ED-054/BALANCE-005 item ("Hafenmark food dependency has no mechanical teeth") by making the dependency itself the mechanic rather than raw adjacency.

name: Charter Prescription and Peninsula-Wide Quo Warranto Echo
statement: Proposes charter revocation Ob rise with age — `Ob = base + floor(charter_age/8)` — and that revoking a charter older than ~16 seasons trigger a public Quo Warranto social-contest scene whose success STILL costs Order −1 in every settlement that faction-type manages peninsula-wide (modeled on Charles II's 1683 revocation of London's charter frightening every chartered English city). Confirmation-for-fee at control transfer yields W+1 and L+1.

name: Entry Terms at Control Transfer (Confirm Privileges vs. Impose Administration)
statement: Proposes a two-option fork at every settlement control transfer (conquest, cession, seizure): Confirm Privileges (Joyeuse Entrée) keeps Charter/Precedent tags, seeds L at 3, caps fiscal stance at Standard for 4 seasons; Impose Administration strips tags, seeds L at 1, Order −1, no stance cap. Fills a hole the L/PS pipeline currently has nothing for — no rule seeds L/PS on control transfer at all.

name: Succession Continuity Rule (The King's Two Bodies)
statement: Proposes that normal-mode succession leave settlement Legitimacy unchanged (the corporate crown never dies — Kantorowicz), with the one-time +1 applying only where an entry/confirmation ceremony is actually performed; contested/ emergency/imposed succession modes instead cost L −1 in every held settlement and check for Regency (H4-074).

name: Residencia / Visita / Rotation — Named Governor-Oversight Toolkit
statement: Proposes naming and completing the Provincial Authority's oversight machinery with three instruments: Visita (cheap surprise inspection, reveals true state, adjusts suspicion), Residencia (mandatory end-of-tenure audit scene where accumulated Grudge/Debt tags are the sworn-complaint evidence dossier), and Rotation policy (clears local capture-tags at the cost of Order −1 and lost local-knowledge Precedent). Grounded on Castilian/ Indies residencia+visita, Ming rule of avoidance, and Ottoman timar rotation.

name: Advowson + Local Interdict — Parish-Level Church/Secular Jurisdiction Seam
statement: Proposes a settlement-scale church-state fight below faction-scale Excommunication: (a) Advowson — every religious building has a patron who nominates its priest (biases PT/church_attention drift), contestable via a Hold Court "darrein presentment" card; (b) Local Interdict — a Church action against one settlement suspending Parish Social Services and dropping Order/PS toward the controller each season it's active, but accruing its own chance of Church L −1 in that settlement (resentment cuts both ways, per Innocent III's 1208–14 English interdict).

name: Plant Colony + Marcher Autonomy — Deriving governor_emergence
statement: Proposes (a) a Plant Colony verb converting a frontier Village/Outpost into a garrison-colony (explicitly never adding a new settlement node — the registry stays at its fixed count) with L seeded at 5 toward the founder and PS at 1 (natives displaced); (b) a Marcher Autonomy derivation making a frontier governor's `suspicion` accrue at half rate while `governor_emergence` (declared, never read in code) rises with defensive wins, feeding the existing faction-emergence pipeline. Grounded on Byzantine stratiotika ktemata and the Habsburg Militärgrenze Grenzer bargain.

name: Weight Loss as Exit (Emigration Made Mechanical)
statement: Proposes a settlement that spends ≥2 consecutive seasons in Dearth or at Order ≤1 lose 1 Settlement Weight (population exodus, lowering Mandate and Treasury contribution), recovering +1 per 4 stable seasons; the nearest higher-Order settlement gets a temporary Prosperity-growth bump (Stadtluft macht frei — towns grew by absorbing refugees). Grounded on Hirschman's Exit.

name: Capital-Posture Ledger Family + Levy:Debase (Currency Ratchet Spine)
statement: Curated-shortlist #1: author one tag family (`Capital-Posture:Debased/ Speculative`) and one one-way ratchet verb (Levy:Debase) once; every other fiscal-crisis card in the 94-entry catalogue (Farm, Charter Fiat, Index Wages, VEN-SE-3's Bonifiche) becomes a variant writing into this ONE family rather than a separate system — nine of ten fiscal-category entries reference it independently.

name: Recoinage / Currency Reset — The Only Exit From the Debasement Ratchet
statement: Curated-shortlist #2: a ratchet with no exit is a dead-end, not a decision. Proposes exactly two grades of one clearing action — clean metallic Recoinage vs. a land-backed Currency Reset that leaves a `Monetary Failure` Precedent — priced to grow costlier the longer debasement is deferred, replacing three near-duplicate raw catalogue entries.

name: Gauge-Indexed Levy — Environment-Auto-Responsive Extraction
statement: Curated-shortlist #3: the one Levy method-fork (of four near-duplicates — Toll, Contribution, Flota Scheduling, Annona Route) that makes extraction auto-responsive to a tracked environmental stat (the Nilometer model) without a per-season roll; folds directly into a periodic-Survey mechanic. The other three should be timing/quality parameters on the existing Levy verb, not separate new verbs.

name: Diversify Corridor — Single-Point-of-Failure Develop Fork
statement: Curated-shortlist #4: a single `route-diversified` vs. `single-corridor` Precedent fork on the Develop verb that generalizes four separate historical reskins at once (Justinian's supply corridor, the Byzantine Annona, the Berlin Blockade, and Suez) — the most-reused geographic-vulnerability lever in the entire 94-entry catalogue.

name: Ever-Normal / Civic Granary — Standing StockLevel Buffer Facility
statement: Curated-shortlist #5: the famine category's spine — five independent catalogue entries (North China, Chongzhen ×2, the Great Famine 1315, cura annonae) converge on "a standing storage facility with a StockLevel stat, auto-drawn on a shock, decaying if diverted." Granary Prefecture / Grain Ministry are a genuinely distinct sibling (price-control capacity, not storage) and should stay a separate mechanic.

name: Staging/Timing-Exposure Rule for Muster/Conquest (Movement Carries Hazard Risk)
statement: Curated-shortlist #6: one rule — exposure accrues while a military force is staged or late inside a hazard window, with per-hazard multipliers — powering four otherwise-separate cards (an anchored fleet caught by weather, a storm window, a plague-carrying muster route, a late convoy). Storm-Season Withdrawal and Staged Demobilization are the SAME mitigation (delay to skip the roll) at different scales; author one shape.

name: Garrison-Pay Debt Clock → Mutiny (Settle Arrears / Contribution System)
statement: Curated-shortlist #7: one `Debt(garrison_pay)` clock with a contagion-on-fire clause, plus two resolving verbs — Settle Arrears (pay it down) and Contribution System (fund it by extracting from occupied territory). The same clock re-pegged for currency debasement becomes Index Wages; author once and share. Grounded on the Spanish Fury at Antwerp (unpaid-garrison mutiny and sack).

name: Embargo Directive — A Directive Aimed at a Third Faction
statement: Curated-shortlist #8: a genuinely new Directive SHAPE — every other Directive targets the settlement it is issued to; Embargo targets a rival THROUGH the governor's own trade, making Comply/Defy read as "how much of my own trade do I sacrifice for someone else's Grudge." Powers the Megarian Decree, Napoleon's Continental System, and a coalition-coordinated multilateral embargo (ABCD Line precedent). Not reducible to an existing verb.

name: Contagion Precedent — One Tag That Cuts Opposite Ways by Scale
statement: Curated-shortlist #9, called "the most novel Ledger idea in the pass": a single tag that LOWERS an outcome's local appeal (terror compliance) while RAISING regional Grudge/Intrigue — the shared substrate for the Magdeburg sack precedent, Drogheda's Outlawed tag, and the Spanish Fury's contagion. Makes atrocity a genuine strategic trade-off instead of a flat penalty.

name: Single Parameterized succession_rule Enum (Not Four Separate Config Flags)
statement: Curated-shortlist #10, explicitly framed as a caution against the reskin failure mode: the raw catalogue independently proposes four separate succession-configuration flags (Partible / Elective / Fratricide / Oath). Proposes ONE `succession_rule` parameter ∈ {primogeniture, partible, elective, oath-bound} plus a post-Contest Fratricide option, all reading the same independent-Military-strength inputs — paired explicitly with an ex-ante authority-cap on delegated heirs/appanage-holders as the preventive companion.

name: Crisis-Gated Charter Seizure (Quo Warranto Bypass on Eroded Leverage)
statement: Curated-shortlist #11: a Charter (domestic or foreign) becomes contestable once its holder's leverage has independently eroded, resolved through arbitration that can override the battlefield outcome — one bypass-branch on the Quo Warranto machinery, gated on a holder-weakness precondition read off the holder's own sheet. Modeled on the 1494 Hanseatic Novgorod expulsion and the Suez Crisis.

name: Quarantine_Tier With Asymmetric Vector Coverage
statement: Curated-shortlist #12, called "the single best teaching mechanic in the plague category": a Sanità/Lazzaretto facility that discounts ONLY trade-vector contagion triggers and explicitly does NOT cover the military-transit vector — a governor who reads it as blanket protection eats a full-severity Crisis. Makes "mitigation is vector-specific" a mechanical lesson, not flavor text.

name: Directive-Immune Ring-Fenced Standing Institution (Water Board / Relief Ministry)
statement: Curated-shortlist #13: one pattern for a dedicated-levy institution that a war Directive cannot silently starve — instances are a flood-specific Water Board, a shared-resource-veto Water Magistracy, and a Cooling-flag Remit discount on a relief-configured Ministry. Answers "how do you stop a war Directive from diverting flood/famine relief funding."

name: Adopt Local Practice — Frontier Heterodoxy vs. Metropole Conformity
statement: Curated-shortlist #14: the only climate-category mechanic that makes heterodoxy-vs-conformity a costed choice — trade a Disposition/Precedent hit with a distant patron for durable resilience against a persistent multi-decade Cooling flag. Wires cleanly into Court Attendance/Suspicion.

name: World-Level Cooling Flag — Correlated Multi-Settlement Shock Layer
statement: Curated-shortlist #15, explicitly flagged design-taste not authoring: the single highest-ceiling and highest-risk idea in the pass — a world-baseline term on Π that makes correlated multi-settlement shocks a real strategic layer forcing an aggregate Extract-vs-Remit policy choice, rather than each shock reading as local. Needs a ruling on whether Π gets this term at all; risks unfun swinginess if built without care.

name: Bidirectional Concern-Domain Ripple Loop (Menu Informs Concern, Concern Informs Menu)
statement: The catalogue's own architectural thesis, illustrated by 12 named cross-domain ripple chains (e.g. debasement→famine→coup, an untaxed chokepoint toll funding the private army that fractures the faction at the next succession): every verb a governor spends to resolve a Geopolitical/ Geographical/Climatic/Economic-triggered card writes a durable Ledger tag or stat trajectory that reshapes that same domain's FUTURE trigger predicates — a closed loop per domain, not a one-shot event resolution.

name: Pastoral Assumption — Low-Ob Church Governor Appointment in a Vacuum
statement: Proposes that when a settlement has no governor (killed, faction collapsed, Stability 0) and holds at least a Chapel, the Church may install a Church Governor at Ob 1 (vs. the normal governor-appointment Ob) — formalizing the historical pattern where the parish priest became de facto civil authority in a post-collapse vacuum (Papal States precedent). Committed as-is per this doc's own §8 same-day post-commit audit.

name: Parish Social Services — Church Buildings as a Stability Dependency Trap
statement: Proposes Church buildings grant a Stability bonus to their host settlement (+0.5 Chapel, +1 Church/Cathedral), making Church infrastructure instrumentally attractive to secular governors — the "Geneva trap": you let the Church in because it helps, then can't remove it because it's load-bearing. Self-audited (§7.1 of the same doc) as a 2–3-season delayed effect on CI, not a timeline short-circuit. Committed as-is.

name: Altonian Alignment — A Faction Can Invite the Invasion
statement: Original proposal: a desperate faction (Mandate ≤2) secretly offers the Altonian invasion strategic intelligence for collaborator status (IP +5 immediate, −2 Ob on Domain Actions during Occupation), discoverable by rival intelligence and politically devastating if exposed. Modeled on Kantakouzenos inviting Ottoman forces into the Byzantine civil war. This doc's own §8 same-day audit REVISED it from a player action to NPC AI behavior the player discovers, on the ground that discovery IS the intended narrative moment, not the invitation itself.

name: IP Visibility Milestones — Mandatory Intelligence Reports at Fixed Thresholds
statement: Proposes mandatory Intelligence Report notifications at Invasion-Pressure 60 and 80, with a Mandate check (Ob 2) forcing any faction currently in inter-faction conflict to divert resources to border defense or fail to respond — modeling intelligence paralysis during factional politics (the 1592 Korean pattern: warnings existed but were not acted on). Committed as-is.

name: RM Presence-to-Underground-Network Conversion During Occupation
statement: Proposes each existing RM Presence marker in an occupied territory convert to +1 Underground Network capacity at Occupation onset — a 5–6-season head start over the base ~1/season build rate — modeling how peacetime political organizing (Solidarity, the Baltic "Singing Revolution") retroactively gains military-resistance value under occupation. Self-audited as balanced (meaningful advantage, not trivializing). Committed as-is.

name: Cell Resilience — Distributed Presence Raises Suppression Ob
statement: Proposes that RM Presence markers in ≥3 settlements within a territory raise Church/Crown suppression-action Ob by +1 there (a distributed cell network survives targeting any single node — the Solidarity pattern), stacking against the existing Inquisitor-presence +1 Ob to RM organizing, producing a deliberate strategic equilibrium between surveillance and resilience. Committed as-is.

name: Governance Transition Scene — Disestablish / Accommodate / Transform
statement: Proposes a three-way choice scene when RM (or any conquering faction) takes a territory holding existing Church/Crown governance infrastructure: Disestablishment (rip it out, −1 Stability for 2 seasons then +0.5 Accord growth), Accommodation (keep it under new oversight, no penalty but slower ideological drop), or Transformation (a 4-season gradual conversion with no interim penalty). Modeled on the India/Germany post-colonial inherit-vs-replace choice. Committed as-is, though the doc's own §5.3 elegance audit suggests collapsing to two options if cognitive load is a concern.

name: Consensus Delay — Anti-Hierarchical Governance Is Slow in a Crisis
statement: Proposes emergency Domain Actions (Muster, Fortify, Emergency Diplomacy) in RM-governed territories take +1 season to resolve by default (the assembly must deliberate), waivable by the RM leader spending a Mandate point to invoke emergency authority — but doing so costs 1 Presence marker in that territory (the community feels its consensus model violated). Models the Zapatista tension: speed requires hierarchy, hierarchy costs legitimacy. Committed as-is.

name: Hidden Thread-Site Bonus — Governance Effectiveness With an Undisclosed Cause
statement: Proposes RM governance cells at Thread-active settlements (former Threadweaving sites, Proximity ≤2 to the Southernmost) receive an unlabeled +0.5 Accord/season bonus, invisible until Thread revelation; on Embrace it doubles to +1 and is revealed, on Denial it persists but stays hidden (narrative irony), on Schism the Embrace faction keeps the doubled bonus and the Denial faction loses it. Committed as-is, self-audited as a "highly elegant" mechanic teaching metaphysics through observed gameplay rather than exposition.

name: RM Accord Ceiling Without Thread Engagement (CUT)
statement: Original proposal: cap RM's achievable Accord at 3 (of 5) without engaging the metaphysical foundation the political model was designed for (the Forgetting means RM can reconstruct the governance form but not its experiential basis). This doc's own §8 same-day audit CUT it: "an invisible cap creates frustration, not narrative," judged redundant with the Hidden Thread-Site Bonus (H4-111), which teaches the same idea through a positive signal instead of an invisible ceiling.

name: Mutual Aid Wealth Bonus, Scale-Capped (CUT)
statement: Original proposal: RM-governed settlements at ≤Town size get +0.5 Wealth/season (communal resource management efficient at small scale), disappearing at City scale — modeling the historical observation that anarchist/consensus governance has worked at village/kibbutz scale but never governed a city. This doc's own §8 same-day audit CUT it as "small modifier, zero narrative moments."

name: Faction six-stat roster (code)
statement: The live Faction dataclass declares six adjustable stats: L (Legitimacy/Mandate, overloaded — see H5-gap), Sta (Stability), W (Wealth), I (Influence), Mil (Military), and intel (added at ratified floor 0.0, unread/unwritten by any live call site). The sixth stat is intel, not standing — Faction.standing is a separate bare int field outside the registry-bounded six.

name: Faction.standing (raw scalar, unbounded)
statement: Faction.standing is a bare int field, defaulting to 0, mutated directly (`crown.standing += 1`) rather than through Faction.adjust() — it never passes through descriptor_registry bounds/clamps the other six stats use. It is read as a Crown Initiative pool bonus and written by crown_initiative.py, absolution.py, and parliamentary_transfer.py.

name: MULTS granular-delta divisor registry
statement: MULTS = {L:20, Sta:10, W:100, I:15, Mil:10, accord:10, pt:10} is the single divisor table every faction-sim module uses to convert an integer "canon stat-tier" delta (e.g. "+1 stat-tier") into the granular float actually applied via Faction.adjust(). There is no 'intel' key, so `adjust('intel', ...)` raises KeyError before any bound is consulted.

name: Territory dataclass (code)
statement: Territory carries tid, owner, accord, pt, garrison(bool), prosperity(int), fort_level(int), templar(bool), uncontrolled_since. It has no occupation marker, no per-settlement Legitimacy/Popular-Support fields, no Franchise field, and no settlement sub-object — the entire "settlement layer" referenced pervasively across this lane's design docs does not exist at this grain in the live model.

name: Standing 0-7 rank ladder (per-officer/player, design)
statement: An eight-position (Standing 0-7) rank track per named faction member, specified per the "Skyrim Eight" dimensions (Title, Initiation Gate, Access, Obligations, Hall Tier, Livery, Mentor, Demotion Trigger) across four primary ladders (Crown, Hafenmark, Varfell, Church) and seven sub-office ladders (Löwenritter, Riskbreaker, Inquisitor, Templar, Guild, Niflhel, Warden of the Thread). No code implements rank progression, titles, or any of the Skyrim-Eight dimensions for any NPC or player character.

name: Shadow Renown (0-10, Riskbreaker covert track)
statement: A private covert-reputation track (0-10, +2/season cap) parallel to public Renown, granting escalating covert benefits (neutral-Disposition floors, action bonus dice, an independent Domain Action, an Exposure-initiation right at 9+). Unbuilt.

name: Deniability Debt (0-7, Riskbreaker)
statement: A tracked-risk counter (0-7) accruing from covert-operation friction, discharging through cooling-off or counter-intelligence. At 3 it triggers a Riskbreaker Exposure card; at 7 (cap) it forces a mandatory Commander demotion. Unbuilt.

name: Franchise (per-territory parliamentary weight)
statement: A 0-5 integer per-territory stat proposed to encode structural political weight (Secession-Wars coalition role, Church penetration, caste gradient, institutional presence) independent of Prosperity or Order. Starting values authored for all 17 territories (sum 47, T15/T16 excluded). Territory dataclass has no such field.

name: 6-stat faction lineup (canon, "Mandate is derived")
statement: LPS-1/LPS-2e canon (Jordan ruling 2026-05-30, partly superseded 2026-08-23) specifies the faction roster as Mandate(derived-headline)/Influence/Wealth/Military/Intel/ Stability, with Legitimacy and Popular Support living per-SETTLEMENT (0-7 each) rather than at faction scale. This is a distinct model from the code's roster (H5-001), where L is a directly-written base descriptor. See H5-G001.

name: Muster pool/Ob formula (code, faction-scale)
statement: "pool = faction.Mil + floor(faction.W / 2); Ob = 1; W cost = -1 up front unconditionally; Overwhelming Mil+5, Success Mil+3, no additional failure penalty." The live, executing formula for the faction-scale Muster action.
formula: pool = Mil + floor(W/2); Ob = 1; W -= 1 always; OW: Mil+5; Success: Mil+3

name: Govern pool/Ob formula (code, faction-scale)
statement: "pool = faction.I; Ob = 2 (fixed); Overwhelming Accord+15, Success Accord+10, Failure Sta-5." The live, executing formula for the faction-scale Govern action.
formula: pool = I; Ob = 2; OW: accord+15; Success: accord+10; Failure: Sta-5

name: Action-selection weights w_unique/w_conquest/w_muster/w_govern
statement: The live per-faction-per-season action-selection policy: base priors 0.30/0.35/0.20/0.15 re-weighted by three RNG-free state signals (conquest target-exists+mil-advantage, undergoverned-territory share, proximate-threat) then renormalized to a probability vector, with a single `rng.random()` draw against cumulative thresholds. Nothing in the prose corpus (card hands, cooldowns, threat-priority AI stack — see H5-G015) obviously owns this policy; it is the actual, sole action-selection mechanism in the live campaign.
formula: w_conquest=0.35*(1+0.5*has_target+0.5*mil_adv); w_muster=0.20*(1+threat); w_govern=0.15*(1+undergoverned_share); w_unique=0.30; renormalize to sum 1

name: Royal Progress Ob (ED-840 closure)
statement: Ob = max(2, floor((7*n_owned - sum(accord)) / 2)); Pool = Influence + Faction.standing; W cost -2 regardless of outcome.
formula: Ob = max(2, floor((7n - Σaccord)/2)); Pool = I + standing

name: Great Work formula (Crown, simplified instant-resolution)
statement: Pool = int(Mandate/Legitimacy L); Ob = 4 (fixed); pays 3 seasons' Wealth (-1/season, 3x) up front. Multi-season Open Pledge tracking (PP-515) is deferred; this is instant resolution only.
formula: Pool = L; Ob = 4; W -= 3 up front

name: Coronation Renewal Ob formula
statement: Ob = floor(Church.L / 2) + 1; Pool = Crown.I. Lifts Excommunication on Success/Overwhelming.
formula: Ob = floor(church_l/2)+1

name: Council of Solmund Ob formula
statement: Ob = floor(CI/30) + 2; Pool = int(Church.L). 1/arc cooldown via council_used_this_arc flag.
formula: Ob = floor(CI/30) + 2

name: Absolution formula (code, [M6_ASSUMPTION_ONE])
statement: Pool = int(Church.I); Ob = 3 (flagged [M6_ASSUMPTION_ONE], not ratified); Church.L cost -1 regardless of outcome; target Sta +1 (Success) / +2 (Overwhelming); Failure decrements Church.standing by 1 (not Church.L).
formula: Pool = I; Ob = 3 [ASSUMPTION]; cost L-1 always

name: Excommunication Tribunal formula — CODE (three-source gap, calibration example)
statement: Three incompatible Excommunication resolution formulas coexist. (1) CODE (tribunal.py/faction_action.py, the executing path): Pool = int(church.L) [+1D on formal grounds]; Ob = round(accused.L) [halved with formal grounds (CI>=40 & Church.L>=4), floor 1]. (2) faction_canon_v30.md §9 / factions_personal_v30.md §8.3: contested resolver "M = Mandate - target Mandate" for a leader target, or flat "Mandate - 2" / "Ob 2" for a non-leader — no halving-with-formal-grounds concept at all. (3) factions_personal_v30.md line 175's separate "CI 60 Territorial Seizure" procedure states yet a third roll, "Church Mandate vs territory owner's Mandate / 2 (round up, min Ob 1)" — a formula actually meant for territorial seizure but textually adjacent enough to invite conflation with Excommunication itself.
formula: CODE: Ob=round(accused.L), halved w/ formal grounds; CANON-A: M=Mandate-target.Mandate; CANON-B: Ob=target.Mandate/2
baseline_ref: catalogue §0.2 row 2 ("round(accused.L*0.5) with formal grounds… half the time")

name: Mass Seizure declaration probability + territory-resolution Ob
statement: Declaration: P(declare) = ((CI-60)/40)^3.3 for CI in [60,100), forced at CI=100; requires Church.L>=4; one-shot lifetime (world.clocks['MASS_SEIZURE_USED']). Per-territory resolution: Pool = Church.I + floor(CI/15); Ob = max(1, 10 - canonical_pt(t.pt) + seizure_ob_modifier); seized on Success/Overwhelming (margin>=1, per the live margin-based degree_from_net ladder, not the retracted net>=2*Ob form).
formula: P=((CI-60)/40)^3.3; Ob=max(1, 10-PT+infra_mod); Pool=I+floor(CI/15)

name: Parliamentary Transfer Pool/Ob formula
statement: Pool = max(0, Proposer.Influence + vote_bloc_modifier[-1,0,+1]); Ob = Holder.Legitimacy + 2 (PARL_MAJORITY_OB_BONUS). Wrapped in a Parliamentary Vote contest whose passed/failed status sets the ±1 pool modifier. 1/arc/faction, CB-gated.
formula: Pool = I + vote_mod; Ob = holder.L + 2

name: Parliamentary Sanction ladder — 5 tiers (calibration-example mechanic)
statement: The Censure/Embargo/Blockade/Combined/Outlawry punitive motions are one parameterized "Parliamentary Sanction" action at ascending severity, sharing propose→vote→apply→ renew-or-lapse structure. Only the mildest tier (Censure) is built in code; the other four exist only as design (Embargo Wealth-1/season, Blockade Military-3-gated Wealth-2/Stability-1, Combined Supermajority Wealth-2+Stability-1/season, Outlawry Supermajority Mandate-2/Stability-2/CB-to-all).
status_evidence: systems/factions/sim/parliamentary_action.py:97-179 (Censure only, TODO block at :163 names the other four as unbuilt)

name: Sanction tier — Censure (built)
statement: Proposer min Mandate 2; Majority vote; target Stability -1, Mandate -1; no proposer cost; one-time.
formula: target: Sta-1, L-1

name: Sanction tier — Embargo (unbuilt)
statement: Proposer min Mandate 3; Majority; target Wealth -1/season until lifted (Majority rescission); proposer pays Wealth -1/season.

name: Sanction tier — Blockade (unbuilt)
statement: Proposer needs Military 3 AND Mandate 3 (Naval gate rider); Majority; target Wealth -2/season + Stability -1 once; proposer Military -1 (garrison).

name: Sanction tier — Combined Embargo+Blockade (unbuilt)
statement: Requires both proposer minimums; Supermajority; target Wealth -2/season + Stability -1/season ongoing + Mandate -1 once; proposer Wealth -1/season + Military -1.

name: Sanction tier — Outlawry (unbuilt, CB-to-all rider)
statement: Proposer min Mandate 5; Supermajority; target Mandate -2, Stability -2, Casus Belli granted to ALL factions; proposer Mandate -1; permanent until petitioned (target needs Mandate>=3 to petition, Supermajority to rescind).

name: Domain Action Ob modifier (PP-686 §3.7)
statement: Ob_modifier = mission_alignment_modifier(-1,0,+1) + cascade_alignment_modifier(-1,0,+1) + expectation_alignment_modifier(±strictness×{1,2}), clamped to ±2. Entirely design-only; faction_action.py has no Mission/Cascade/strictness inputs to any of its Ob calculations.
formula: Ob_mod = clamp(mission_align + cascade_align + sign(dev)*strictness*{1,2}, -2, 2)

name: Mandate LPS-1 size-weighted aggregate formula
statement: Mandate(faction) = clamp(round(7*T/(T+6)), 0, 7), T = Σ_s W_s*(0.5*L_s + 0.5*PS_s)/7 over controlled settlements, W_s = base(Type)+Prosperity+FacilityTier. This ratified aggregate is a counterfactual about unbuilt code — no per-settlement L/PS field exists anywhere in the engine (see H5-004), and Faction.L is written directly by every faction action module as if it WERE Mandate.
formula: Mandate = clamp(round(7T/(T+6)),0,7); T=Σ W_s(0.5L_s+0.5PS_s)/7

name: Territory Influence / National Influence formulas (franchise proposal)
statement: territory_influence = controller_bonus(+2) + infrastructure_count(0-3) + npc_presence(+1) + governor_bonus(+1), clamped 0-7. national_influence = clamp(round(Σ(TI×Franchise) / Σ(Franchise)), 1, 7), proposed to REPLACE the scalar Influence stat (faction.I) wherever it appears as a roll pool. Faction.I is read directly, unweighted, at every one of its ~15 call sites in the live sim (H5-011, H5-014-020 etc.) — this formula has zero implementation.
formula: TI = 2*ctrl + infra_count + npc_presence + gov_bonus, clamp 0-7; NI = clamp(round(Σ(TI*F)/ΣF),1,7)

name: Fiscal Stance yield formula (ED-FA-0008, proposed)
statement: yield(settlement) = Prosperity * k * rate_mult * compliance(L); compliance(L) = 0.5 + L/14; rate_mult in {0.75 Light, 1.0 Standard, 1.5 Extraction}. Proposed, not ratified; no per-settlement tax/Treasury model exists in code to consume it.
formula: yield = Prosperity * k * rate_mult * (0.5 + L/14)

name: Fractional Province PV-share formula
statement: Settlement PV share = (settlement.Prosperity / Σ province settlement.Prosperity) * province base PV, per-faction re-aggregated at Accounting; zero-denominator guard distributes equally (floor(base/n), remainder to Seat) and forces province Accord to 0.
formula: share_s = (P_s / ΣP) * base_PV

name: CI institutional weight (Church political forums)
statement: Church's CI institutional weight = floor(CI/20), applied as +votes on Parliament tallies or +margin M on d+σ-resolver checks (never "bonus dice" — no forum still rolls a raw pool post-Treaty migration). Opposing-Church vote contributions reduce by floor(CI/30), floored at 0 (never negative).
formula: church_weight = floor(CI/20); opponent_reduction = floor(CI/30), floored at 0
baseline_ref: catalogue references CI/20 relationship implicitly via faction_layer §5.3

name: Crown Initiative (3-mode faction-unique action)
statement: Crown's unique action, dispatched via select_initiative_mode heuristic among Royal Progress, Great Work, and Coronation Renewal (Coronation Renewal fires ONLY during active excommunication). Canon prose names this action "Royal Decree" (Mandate vs Ob 2, one flat degree table) — a different name AND a different formula than the code's "Crown Initiative."

name: Excommunication (Church faction-unique action)
statement: Church attempts to strip a rival's legitimacy via a single-roll abstraction of the §7.1 Tribunal, gated on Church.L>=3. Outcomes: Overwhelming/Success set target.excommunicated and apply -1 L (escalated -2 total with formal grounds, plus CI+3); Failure costs Church L-1 and gives target L+1 (sympathy).

name: Council of Solmund (Church faction-unique action)
statement: Rare 1/arc Church gathering: Overwhelming grants L+2-stat-tier plus a formal censure (-1 L) against the highest-L rival parliamentary faction; Success grants L+1; the "choose a Cardinal Focus" effect is logged but not state-mutating (no Cardinal Focus track in the v18 schema).

name: Absolution (Church faction-unique action)
statement: Church spends L-1 to grant a lowest-Stability non-excommunicated rival faction a Stability recovery (+1 Success, +2 Overwhelming); gated on Church.L>=4 to protect the Excommunication prerequisite floor. Failure decrements Church.standing (not L).

name: Mass Seizure (Church territorial-conversion action)
statement: Fully-implemented, one-shot-lifetime probabilistic Church action converting every Church-prominent territory with a Chapel+ building. NEVER CALLED — faction_action.py's _faction_specific_unique Church priority chain is Excommunication → Council → Absolution only; mass_seizure has zero production callers anywhere in engine/ or systems/, confirmed independently across a 40-seed campaign instrumentation trace.

name: Parliamentary Censure (universal fallback faction action)
statement: The universal fallback occupying the faction-unique action slot whenever a faction's own unique chain (or lack thereof) returns NOOP — reused rather than a new bucket, per ED-FA-0012. Only two voices are declared (proposer=A, target=B, chosen as highest-L rival via realist-balance-of-power targeting); every other parliamentary faction abstains.

name: Parliamentary Territory Transfer (universal action)
statement: Universal CB-gated territory-transfer action wrapping a Parliamentary Vote contest; 4 narrative modes (Adversarial/Consensual/Punishment/Appeasement) each accepting different Casus Belli sources; 1/arc/faction; last-territory and self-transfer protections at declaration stage. v12c-validated at N=1000 for balance.

name: Charter of Liberties (Hafenmark faction-unique action)
statement: Hafenmark's declared unique action per faction_canon §6; the sim module is a pure stubwire no-op with zero implemented logic, reachable only by a pipeline-reach test.

name: Hafenmark Equipment (Wagenburg + Bombards tactic cards)
statement: Pure stub; content pending a contamination audit (HAFENMARK-TACTIC-EXTENSION-CONTENT-001); canon design doc not yet authored.

name: Home Sanctuary (Church T9 build-up protection)
statement: Jordan-directed mechanic (T9 invasion Ob +4 for first 12 seasons; ends on Church PT<3 / L<2.5 / any faction holds CB vs Church) exists only as a directive comment; both entry points (t9_invasion_modifier, check_sanctuary_active) are pure stubs — the latter has ZERO callers anywhere including tests.

name: Infrastructure Reclamation (Church invasion bonus)
statement: Jordan directive exists in comment (attacker pool += infra_count + max(0,PT-3), defender pool -= min(3, floor(bonus/2))) but compute_reclamation_bonus is a pure stub.

name: Varfell Mandate Action (placeholder, broken mechanism)
statement: Placeholder-named (was 'vaynards_hall'; renamed for identity-coding concerns). The prior mechanism (W-1 + Mil-1 -> L+1) was flagged BROKEN by Jordan 2026-05-17 as a double-cost asymmetry versus other factions' Mandate actions; both name and mechanism await a Varfell contamination audit. Pure stub.
baseline_ref: catalogue §1.3 "Varfell has no working unique action"

name: Varfell Territorial Acquisition (placeholder, mechanism v12c-validated)
statement: Placeholder-named (was 'einhir_revival'). Mechanism shape (Pool=Varfell.I; Ob=max(1,1+PT*weight) for uncontrolled territory; PT degradation; no Stability penalty on Failure per the v12b death-spiral fix) is balance-validated at N=1000 per v12c §4.1, but the cultural-framing identity wrapping awaits contamination audit. Pure stub.

name: Generic Asymmetric Proceeding (§7 Tribunal, non-Excommunication)
statement: run_tribunal(accused, accusers, proceeding_type, ...) covers §7.2 Succession Contest and §7.3 Heresy Investigation Lifecycle generically. Only run_excommunication_tribunal (the §7.1 specialization) is implemented; the generic dispatcher is a stubwire no-op with zero callers anywhere including tests.

name: Treaty proposal (propose_treaty)
statement: The sole entry point to CREATE a treaty. Stubwired to a typed no-op (does not raise despite its own module docstring and function-summary both still declaring "raises" / "still raises" — a code↔doc divergence, not a stale comment). No canonized non-Senator-Outward formation path exists, and crown_initiative.py implements no "Senator Outward" mode at all — so no live path anywhere creates a Crown Treaty.

name: Treaty expiration (process_treaty_expirations)
statement: Fully implemented per-Treaty independent lapse roll at TREATY_LAPSE_RATE_DEFAULT=0.90 (matches canon's 0.90 default within [0.90,0.95]). Zero production callers anywhere in engine/ or systems/ — confirmed by direct grep in addition to the flow-skeleton's independent trace.

name: Universal Succession Contest
statement: A two-stage generalized succession framework firing on any faction leader's elimination: Stage 1 (deterministic+stochastic resolver, who leads) then Stage 2 (deterministic strength-gap G, whether the realm fragments — G>=3 unified, G=2 unified-fractious subject to Disposition, G<=1 splits). Subsumes and generalizes the earlier Crown-specific baralta_crown_claim_v30 §2 mechanic. No code anywhere implements any succession logic for any faction; "succession" appears only in one comment (parliamentary_action.py TODO) and a generic stub (tribunal.run_tribunal).

name: Faction split asset-division table
statement: On a Succession-Contest split: provinces divide by nearest-contender proximity (winner keeps capital+adjacent); Mandate/Influence 60/40; Wealth 70/30; military units resolve per-unit Loyalty checks; Stability winner=current-1, splinter=2. Unbuilt.

name: RM Settlement Emergence (per-settlement RM takeover)
statement: Extends the existing settlement_layer §6.2 Stage-2→5 RM emergence pathway: a single settlement at Order=0 (hard threshold, not <=1) AND PT<=1 AND local Disposition toward Yrsa Vossen >=+3 may fire RM governance takeover without the province-scale Cultural Uprising gate. Max once per province per 4 seasons. Unbuilt (RM/Restoration Movement has no code representation in this lane at all).

name: Faction Collapse Exit Procedure
statement: Six-step collapse procedure on Stability=0 at Accounting: Mandate→0 immediate; all controlled territories→Uncontrolled (Accord→0/Revolt, units Masterless, claimable via March/Conquest target-variant per ED-FA-0006 DISTILL); named officers→Independent; affiliated PCs lose Standing bonuses; Parliamentary seat lost; victory conditions close (Reconstitution via Influence resolver 3 consecutive seasons restores at 50% frozen stats). Includes a once-per-campaign Survival Exception at Stability 1. No code implements any step of this — Faction/Territory dataclasses have no collapse-detection or state-transition logic.

name: Stability Trigger system (5 canonical triggers)
statement: Stability changes ONLY from five named triggers (Territorial Occupation/Loss, Unfavourable Treaty Terms, Antagonistic Parliamentary Vote, Major Subterfuge, Failed Military Engagement) plus the separate Accounting Stability Check cascade. This "closed causal set" governance model is entirely unbuilt — the live code adjusts Stability ad hoc from within individual action modules (Govern Failure -5, parliamentary_action Censure -1, etc.) with no trigger-registry or PP-403-repeal enforcement anywhere.
baseline_ref: catalogue §9 (settlement governance unbuilt) — this is the faction-scale analogue, distinct subsystem

name: Trigger 5 — Failed Military Engagement (3-condition gate, ED-876 fixed)
statement: All three must hold: committed force (pool>=4), clear defeat (net<=0, Partial excluded), and severity (net<=-2 OR named-officer capture/death) — the earlier "pool>=6" gate clause was DELETED (ED-876, 2026-05-28) because it made Stability-collapse probability non-monotonic in faction strength (~25x spike at the 4D→6D pool boundary); it survives only as a cost-table severity escalator. Unbuilt.

name: Territorial Occupation (military presence without control)
statement: A distinct state from formal control: 3-season automatic control-transfer window, per-season Stability/Wealth/Military costs to both sides, a free Resistance Check for the displaced faction, and interaction rules with Church Seizure and Political Vacuum (PP-500). No "occupation marker" concept exists anywhere in the Territory dataclass or any sim module — conquest transfers ownership immediately (H5-P-004), skipping the entire occupation phase this design specifies.

name: Treaty negotiation (3-phase process)
statement: Positioning roll (resolver, M=own Influence-target Influence, sets opening terms) → Concession declaration (no roll, player negotiation) → Ratification roll (resolver, M=Mandate-2, per signatory) with an optional third-party Guarantor. Entirely unbuilt — treaty.py has no positioning/concession/ratification machinery at all.

name: Casus Belli economy (formal standing right to act)
statement: CB grants a free first military_advance (or Ob-1) against a target; consumed on first use or expires after 1 season (later revised to 3 seasons per ED-NEW-001); multiple distinct-source CBs may be held simultaneously. In code, world.casus_belli is an OPTIONAL duck-typed dict with ZERO production writers — see H5-G012.

name: Fail Forward complication system (BG Domain Actions, PP-177)
statement: Every BG-mode Domain Action gains a mandatory Failure complication (from a per-action complication table: e.g. Govern Failure → Prosperity -1; Muster Failure → no unit + W-1) and a player-chosen Minor complication on Partial (Standing-1 OR Public Instability +1). WORKING DESIGN, not committed; faction_action.py's Failure branches apply only the flat stat penalties already captured in H5-010/011/013-020 — no complication table exists.

name: Card-hand + Cooldown action economy (PP-177, ci_political §5)
statement: Each faction has a fixed hand of typed cards (Legionary/Consul/Senator/Pontifex/ Tribune/Prefect/Diplomat/Colonist/Recess) mapping to permitted Domain Actions, spent into a Cooldown Track (1-2 season duration by type) that gates repeat use. This is a structurally DIFFERENT action-economy architecture from the live model (H5-012's single weighted-stochastic draw with no per-faction action-type inventory or cooldown at all) — the two coexist in the corpus with no reconciliation note between them.

name: AI threat-priority posture stack
statement: A 6-tier priority stack (Existential → Defend → Consolidate → Counter-threat → Expand → Opportunistic) each faction evaluates in order every season, replacing a prior EXPAND/CONSOLIDATE/DEFEND/DIPLOMACY posture. Unbuilt — faction_take_action's live selection (H5-012) has no priority-stack concept, only state-conditioned probability re-weighting.

name: Fractional Province Consolidation (Domain Action)
statement: A faction holding >=75% of a fractional province's Prosperity-weighted PV may declare Consolidation: Influence vs Ob = remaining-non-faction-PV-share*2 (round up); each non-faction settlement's controller chooses Submit (transfer, Order-2) or Resist (mandatory siege next season). Unbuilt.

name: Fragmentation Check (fractional-province stability roll)
statement: Per-Accounting roll for every fractional province: Pool = Seat-holder's Influence; Ob = 2 + (count of non-Seat-held settlements). Failure allows the non-Seat controller to declare Secession (permanent loss until reconquest, restricted to national-faction controllers per PP-TBD). Unbuilt.
formula: Ob = 2 + non_seat_settlement_count

name: Franchise Dynamics (shift triggers)
statement: Six named ±1-Franchise shift triggers (sustained stable control 4+ seasons, revolt, Church Seizure, Löwenritter Coup, Parliament non-functional freeze, caste-reform event TBD), floored at 1 once a territory has any representation. Unbuilt (Franchise field itself does not exist).

name: Recognition Fork (Confirm vs. New-Grant) — Standing ladder cross-rank dimension
statement: A rank-advancement grant may resolve as Honryoando (Confirm — narrative ceremony, no mechanical unlock, eased demotion threshold for a year) or Shinonkyūyo (New-Grant — full unlock, new Obligation). Applies uniformly to every Standing-3/5 Recognition Event across all four primary ladders.

name: Court Attendance and Hostage-Kin
statement: Ratified (ED-FA-0020) mandatory yearly Court Attendance for Standing 4+ absentee governors (1 AP + Treasury cost; skipping doubles Suspicion accrual), plus an optional Hostage-Kin exchange easing demotion risk at the cost of exposing a Knot-relationship NPC as a legible target. Unbuilt.

name: Patron-Sponsored Performance Audit
statement: Optional triplicate-task-ledger overlay on Required Obligations available to any Standing-6+ NPC's subordinate chain (missed Obligation → Waiting Order at 1 season → patron review at 2 → Demotion Magnitude-1 at 3); auto-lapses within 1 season if the sponsoring patron is demoted/dies/vacates. PROPOSED, unbuilt.

name: Guild entry/mastership forks (Guarantor path; Capital-gated Free Mastership)
statement: Ratified (ED-FA-0022/23): entry may go via 3-5 Guarantor freemen (jointly liable, Book of the Eparch precedent) or the existing sole-patron path; Free Mastership may be bought outright (skipping the caste-vulnerable Masterpiece Examination) at the cost of a durable "Upstart" tag (-2 Disposition from peers, no Apprentices for 4 seasons, -1 Ob for accusers on Schism/expulsion checks). Unbuilt.

name: Consecration (Church leadership elevation)
statement: Confessor-Presumptive → Confessor requires Holy See concurrence (narrative +1 Ob per low-CI year-arc), unanimous College of Prelates, and a mandatory Zoom-In ceremony; a "Consecration under duress" branch exists if the Hafenmark Crown Succession Contest is concurrently active. Unbuilt.

name: Baralta Crown Succession Contest (Crown-specific, superseded)
statement: The original Crown-only succession mechanic (Löwenritter/Hafenmark/Church claimants rolling pool vs Ob 3, ties broken by claim-type) that faction_succession_split_v30 §2 explicitly subsumes as a special case, retaining only Baralta's Deed-claim and Consecration Crisis as Crown-specific overlays on the generic framework.
status_evidence: systems/factions/faction_succession_split_v30.md:171 ("this ED's generalized Succession Contest subsumes baralta_crown_claim_v30 §2")

name: Consecration Crisis (Church Stability-gated Hafenmark-wins branch)
statement: If Hafenmark wins Crown succession, Church Stability at that moment forks the outcome: >=4 Himlensendt refuses Consecration (unconsecrated rule, CI+3, 3-season performance trial); <=3 Consecrates under duress (CI-5, Church Stability-3). Retained as a Crown-specific overlay on the generalized Succession Contest (H5-049); unbuilt.

name: Varfell Path B — Southernmost Dominion victory path (STRUCK)
statement: A proposed reduced-condition (4-condition Warden Recognition track) redesign of an entire alternate victory path for Varfell. The whole document, all variants, is struck absolutely by canon §B GD-1 (peninsula-only victory) — "preserved as supersession-trail evidence," the mechanic itself is dead. Peninsular Sovereignty (11+/15 territories) is the sole victory condition for every faction including Varfell.

name: L" field conflation — Legitimacy vs. Mandate
statement: faction_canon_v30 §5.3 records that `engine/cross_scale/parliamentary_bridge.py` still comments "Mandate == Faction.L pre-LPS-1" — but Jordan's 2026-08-23 ruling ("Legitimacy is a base") made `fac.legitimacy`/`Faction.L` a declared base descriptor, a DIFFERENT quantity from the LPS-1 aggregate Mandate (H5-028). Every faction-sim module I read (crown_initiative, excommunication, tribunal, council_solmund, absolution, parliamentary_action, parliamentary_transfer) writes and reads `.L`/`.adjust('L',...)` as if it WERE Mandate — none compute or consume the LPS-1 aggregate. What is NOT settled, per the document's own words: "whether every call site that writes it means Legitimacy or means Mandate.

name: Govern — three incompatible formulas (calibration example)
statement: Three distinct Govern formulas coexist. CODE (executing): Pool=Influence, Ob=2 fixed (H5-011). ci_political_v30.md §4.2: resolver M=Mandate-difficulty, difficulty= max(1,(Ob-1)*2), Ob=floor(Prosperity/2)+1 (-1 in capital) — different pool STAT (Mandate not Influence) and a Prosperity-derived Ob rather than a flat 2. military_layer_v30/parliamentary_transfer_v30 corroborate the floor(Prosperity/2)+1 Ob as the ratified canon form. Neither the pool-stat nor the Ob-shape match the code.

name: Faction unique-action roster — canon table vs. code dispatch
statement: faction_canon_v30 §9's "Tactic/Unique Action Overview" table names a specific, per-faction roster as if authoritative: Crown "Royal Decree" (Mandate vs Ob 2, flat table); Church "Excommunication" + "CI 60 Territorial Seizure" (two separate actions); Hafenmark "Sovereign Authority Doctrine" (Mandate vs Ob 4); Varfell "The Private Collection" (Intel vs Ob 2); Guilds "Economic Leverage" (Wealth vs target Wealth). The live dispatch (faction_action.py::_faction_specific_unique) implements NONE of these as named or formulated: Crown routes to "Crown Initiative" (3 different modes, none named "Royal Decree"); Church's chain is Excommunication→Council of Solmund→Absolution (Mass Seizure/"CI 60 Territorial Seizure" exists in code but is never called — H5-037); Hafenmark, Varfell, and Guilds have ZERO faction-specific unique action in the live dispatch — all three fall straight to the universal Parliamentary-Censure fallback.
baseline_ref: catalogue §1.3 ("Varfell and Hafenmark have no working unique action at all")

name: faction_action.py's §2.3 Legitimacy citation does not match current faction_layer_v30
statement: faction_action.py:498 cites "[canonical: faction_layer §2.3 loser-Legitimacy-on-transfer, v17]" for the conquest-loser's L-10 penalty. The CURRENT faction_layer_v30.md §2.3 ("Occupation Effects") is a table of TCV/Wealth/Military/Stability/Accord effects with no Legitimacy row at all — the citation resolves to a section that has since been rewritten out from under it, a citation-drift that predates the v30 restructure and was never re-verified.

name: world.casus_belli has zero production writers
statement: parliamentary_transfer._available_cb reads the optional duck-typed world.casus_belli dict for every §3 CB source except Crown-constitutional-restoration — but nothing in the live tree ever writes to it. The Crown-restoration source is appended only to _available_cb's own LOCAL list, never to world.casus_belli itself; propose_transfer's Partial-outcome CB grant only extends the ledger IF it is already a populated dict (it never creates one). Result: in a fresh campaign, every CB source except Crown's auto-refreshing restoration clause is permanently unreachable — Adjacent Instability, Einhir Revival Partial, Military Conquest, Treaty-violation, Excommunication-related, and Conviction Scar accumulation CBs can never actually gate a Transfer.

name: Sanction" naming collision (Parliamentary Sanction vs. renamed Authority pressure point)
